modules.factor: ONE factor against the locked v2.0 default plan (cell PLAN, configs/baseline/slurp-native-default-plan-lock-baseline-v1.json): native_episode.roles.solver.samples = 5 with decoding_overrides = {temperature: 0.7, seed_offset: 0} and commit = {policy: saea-commit-plurality-support-v1, min_support: 3, similarity_threshold: 0.8} -- the sealed B2 v3 grouped-Solver form -- and native_episode.deliver_normaliser REMOVED, because rails.native_episode_config refuses a grouped Solver together with the delivery normaliser node; the v3 projection moves to S3-3's offline scoring instead. The roster is the clean subset of the S3-1 construction roster, SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01C (625 TRAIN construction rows) rather than TRAIN Fold A, with that roster's own promoted featcache packets and its own two query-vector pins. Everything else -- knowledge_stores.slot-contracts, phase_material, the task instruction template, the np4 x 24,576 geometry, the scorers -- is byte-identical to cell PLAN, and tests/unit/test_stage3_rollout_baseline_cell.py is the byte proof. Every sample is custodied in solver_group (invariant I7g); the delivered answer is the plurality commit and is read for nothing but custody.
modules.roster_is_part_of_the_factor: the clean subset of the S3-1 construction roster (SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01C, 625 TRAIN construction rows, roster receipt docs/receipts/rosters/slurp-stage3-construction-r01c.json, split identity f56bc386776421aec2d8001d8697611b01c9b0562885a462759b15531e2f4515) replaces TRAIN Fold A, with R01's own promoted featcache packets (superset, bound by packet id) and the two R01C query-vector subsets. R01C is R01 minus the 175 rows whose utterances are knowledge-card sources; see r01c_narrowing_2026_09_23 in the protocol document. No comparator is defined on this roster.
modules.declared_keys_that_are_not_factors: native_episode.finite_completion_policy = deliver-latest-or-abstain (item E13) and native_episode.react_exhaustion_policy = continue-without-answer (item E22), both required of every live SLURP native cell by scripts/checks/finite_completion_policy_check.py. Neither renders a request byte; each only decides whether a finite completion or a ReAct exhaustion aborts the flight or the row is RETAINED with its terminal disposition.
modules.zero_tool_authority: no role carries phase_tools; the native task-contract call ceiling is 0 and no tools array is rendered on any request (item E23 repair form 0-B).
modules.purpose: Cell ROLL-1 (S3-2): produce five custodied Solver samples per row of the S3-1 construction roster so that S3-3 can score the copies and select the best/worst pair on every disagreeing row, and S3-4 can ask the frozen core what distinguished the better answer from the worse. prepared_phase_supply.note: NOT built by this registration and deliberately NOT pinned here. core.flight.repin builds this cell's OWN model-free artifact under its own run id at the readiness flip (item E16: a prepared artifact is evidence only for the implementation that produced it, so nothing is inherited from cell PLAN or from B2 v3), then pins it into configs/baseline/slurp-native-stage3-rollout-baseline-v1.json and into the experiment fragment's 'preparation' readiness requirement, which carries PENDING placeholders until then. No relpath or sha256 is written into these plans, because with no current pin the re-pin tool builds no old-value mapping and would leave a placeholder here forever. --allow-output-change must never be passed.

r01c_narrowing_2026_09_23.what: Cell ROLL-1 was re-registered from the 800-row construction roster R01 onto its clean subset R01C (SLURP-STAGE3-CONSTRUCTION-R01C, 625 rows). Nothing else about the cell moved: the same arm, the same grouped-Solver factor, the same knowledge stores, the same geometry, the same scorers, the same four run ids and the same attempt ids.
r01c_narrowing_2026_09_23.why: rails.runner.run_speech_native_agent_loop refuses a run whose query samples intersect the bound composite snapshot's own source_sample_ids (the union over the composed stores, rails.knowledge_stores._composite). Item S3-1k removed the overlap the train-exemplars store contributed by re-pointing it at the release size-pool-annotated-exemplars-minus-r01. The residual intersection was 175 R01 rows whose utterances are card sources of the two AUTHORED semantic stores (intent-boundaries-v1, 57 recordings; slot-contracts-v2, 155 recordings; union 175 utterances), and an authored card cannot be re-pointed model-free. Those rows therefore left the QUERY side.
r01c_narrowing_2026_09_23.authority: coordinator decision 102, pending owner confirmation. A later top-up draw (R02) that restores the roster to about 800 clean rows is a separate item.
r01c_narrowing_2026_09_23.how: scripts/build_slurp_stage3_construction_clean_subset.py: a pure SELECTION of R01 with zero model, tool, encoder, tokenizer, scorer, GPU and network contacts (an offline socket guard is armed before the first input is opened and recorded 0 attempts). Exclusion is by UTTERANCE, the same rule scripts/build_slurp_stage3_r01_excluded_exemplar_store.py applies from the knowledge side. Every surviving roster item, runtime-view row and query-vector line is the parent artifact's own bytes, in the parent's order.
r01c_narrowing_2026_09_23.unchanged_pins: The featcache packet promotion receipt (800 packets, a1664e34742dcd2d59c226da701395edf41d150bbbf8db4acc0cdae9c3c0250f) stays pinned: core.flight.FlightRuntime.speech_packet_bindings binds packets BY ID and refuses only the samples a receipt does NOT cover, so a superset is accepted and all 625 R01C packet ids are bound. The R01 D1 media supplement stays pinned for the same reason: contracts.gate_media_identity._d1_media_supplement_records looks each FLOWN id up and never requires an exact cover.
r01c_narrowing_2026_09_23.still_owed_by_root: This narrowing does NOT flip readiness and touches no readiness state field. The prepared_phase_supply artifacts pinned in both baselines were minted over the old populations, and core.flight.runtime._phase_seed_inputs binds a prepared artifact to the composed config, the split identity and the packet map -- so both must be re-minted by scripts/flights/repin_cell.py before either cell flies. That same re-pin recomputes the composed and protocol hashes once more and rewrites every document that quotes them, including the four exposure-ledger rows.
